description: issue #691: each melody duration MUST be positive (spec/interaction-events.md:388-390: "Each duration is a positive number"); a non-positive duration (here 0) raises `ol-range` with params {operation:"play", value}, folding non-finite in exactly like `note`/`rest`. No `sound` event is emitted. The instruction event is still emitted before the diagnostic halts the statement.
